# Private finding: comment edit review (step 5)

- The edit-window refusal in editComment throws a plain Error. The handler turns that into a 500 with the message as the body. The error-response policy says new error bodies use the errors-key shape, so this path breaks it.
- No rule gives a status code for a refused edit. The author left a code comment saying so. When a reviewer sees a spec gap like this, flag the body shape separately from the status code, and do not invent a status.
- The 30-minute value matches the edit-window policy. Check the constant against the policy, not against the test values.

content.text:
**Answer to question 1:** A comment may be edited for 30 minutes after it was created. Source: `policy-edit-window.md`. No other note gives a different window.

## Review of the comment editing change

Diff reviewed: `git diff` plus the new migration and test file. Files touched: `article.controller.ts`, `article.service.ts`, `schema.prisma`, a new migration, and a new test file.

| Rule | Source | Code value | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window is 30 minutes after creation | `policy-edit-window.md` | `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000` at `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:563` | PASS |
| Refused edit uses the errors-key body shape | `policy-error-response.md` | Window refusal is `throw new Error('the edit window for this comment has passed')` at `article.service.ts:590`. The handler sends a 500 with the message as the body, not `{"errors":{...}}` | FLAG |
| editedAt is nullable and starts null | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | `editedAt DateTime?` in `schema.prisma`, with no default | PASS |
| editedAt is set on each successful edit | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | `data: { body, editedAt: new Date() }` in `editComment` | PASS |
| Migration does not change existing rows | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | `ADD COLUMN "editedAt" TIMESTAMP(3)` with no backfill, in `migrations/20261030120000_comment_edited_at/migration.sql` | PASS |
| Migration has a one-line undo note | `policy-release-checklist.md` | `-- Undo: ALTER TABLE "Comment" DROP COLUMN "editedAt";` | PASS |
| Migration folder is timestamped | `code-migrations.md` | `20261030120000_comment_edited_at` | PASS |
| 404 and 422 bodies use the errors-key shape | `policy-error-response.md` | `{ errors: { comment: ['not found'] } }` at line 584 and `{ errors: { body: ["can't be blank"] } }` at line 567 | PASS |
| Lookup is filtered by the caller as author | `code-comment-ownership.md` | `where: { id, authorId: userId, article: { slug } }` | PASS |
| Test is a `*.test.ts` under `app/src/tests/services` and uses the mocked database | `code-test-layout.md` | `app/src/tests/services/comment-edit.service.test.ts`, using `prismaMock` | PASS |

**Notes, not flags:**
- `code-comment-ownership.md` says a non-owner gets a 404 with an empty body on delete. `editComment` returns a 404 with an errors body. I followed `policy-error-response.md` for new error responses. The two notes describe different routes, so they do not conflict.
- `code-comment-model.md` says there is no `editedAt` field today. The schema change adds one, which is the intended change.
- `policy-release-checklist.md` asks for `npx prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database. I did not run it in this session, so that check is unverified.
- The code comment at `article.service.ts:588` says no rule sets a status for a refused edit. I agree. The rules I was given do not set one, so I did not flag the 500 status itself. I flagged only the body shape.

**Verdict: NOT APPROVED**

The flag is the refusal body at `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:590`, which breaks `policy-error-response.md`. The change needs a refusal body in the errors-key shape before it can be approved. The status code is not set by any rule, so that choice needs an owner's decision.

Private finding written to `private-out/step5-finding.md`.
